path.description: The text file to edit: relative to the workspace root, or absolute inside it.

old_string.description: The exact text to replace, including whitespace and indentation, without the line numbers that read prints. It must occur exactly once in the file unless replace_all is true.

new_string.description: The text that replaces old_string; it must differ from it. Empty text deletes old_string.

replace_all.description: Replace every occurrence of old_string instead of requiring exactly one.
